integrity: The universal claim follows from exact prime-adic divisibility and the elementary bound \(p^a\ge a+1\); no finite search is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a sufficient parameter region \(u\ge v\), not a complete classification for \(u<v\). The counter-ray \(v=3u\) shows noninjectivity outside the region but does not classify all outside parameters. The finite verifier is regression evidence only.
title: Prime-power injectivity of \(n^u\tau(n)^v\) when \(u\ge v\)
